messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@aurorafin.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorafin.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP security gates — evidence cadence and retention questions

Michael — thanks again for the demo last week. AuroraFin's security team is assembling the MAP and we want to lock down a few practical items so we can hit the December 15 go/no-go milestone:

1) SOC 2 evidence: can Redwood provide a concise index (artifact name, owner, date produced) rather than full bundles? Our auditors want an evidence mapping.
2) SIG/CAIQ: what's your target for returning the completed CAIQ? We typically expect lane-by-lane answers so we can triage exceptions quickly.
3) DPA & retention: we need a firm statement of default retention windows for logs and embeddings, and where EU residency applies. We will ask legal to review redlines but want operational clarity up front.

Can you assign a point person (ops/security) to coordinate an evidence intake session this week?

Thanks,
Elena Costa
Head of Security Programs
AuroraFin

--

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP security gates — evidence cadence and retention questions

Elena — appreciated the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below. I'm looping in Irene (security) and Vanessa (solutions/procurement) to own artifacts and contract language.

1) SOC 2 evidence index: yes — attached is a one-page index that maps SOC 2 control families to representative artifacts (policy doc, runbook, third-party attestation, config export). We can populate with dates/owners during the intake. Expecting this will cut the auditor review time. (Attachment: redwood_soc2-evidence-index.pdf)

2) SIG/CAIQ: we use a lane-based approach. We can return a completed CAIQ (with lane notes) within 5 business days after the intake session if there are no carve-outs. If you want staged delivery, we can prioritize high-risk lanes first (data residues, encryption, tenant isolation).

3) DPA & retention: our standard DPA default: logs retained 90 days, embeddings retained 30 days by default for hosted API; customers on Dedicated/Private can configure and contract alternative windows. For EU residency we offer region-bound processing in eu-west-1 and an on-prem option when required. I'll attach a short retention summary. (Attachment: dpa-data-retention-summary.xlsx)

Next steps:
- Irene: can you run a 45-minute evidence intake session Wed 12/1 or Thu 12/2?
- Vanessa: can you surface any DPA redlines Aurora Fin commonly asks for so we can prepare draft language?

If all that lines up, we'll aim to complete the CAIQ and SOC 2 index by 12/10 and ship contract-ready DPA language by 12/13 so your legal team can review ahead of the 12/15 milestone.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Elena — confirmed for Thu 11:00 PT. Also adding procurement notes so legal can scope redlines efficiently. A few practical points from our side:

- Contract path: because AuroraFin expects EU residency in parts of the workflow, please indicate which products you plan to run in-region vs hosted global. That determines the DPA annexes.
- Retention toggles: hosted API customers can choose embeddings data retention 0/30/90 days at account-level; logs are 90 days by default and can be extended to 365 under Dedicated. We'll include clear language in the DPA appendix.
- Evidence transfer: we will provide the SOC 2 index and CAIQ answers as PDF/Word artifacts in a shared Drive folder. For anything that contains sensitive config exports we will provide sanitized exports and a checklist for auditors to request full access under an NDA.

I'll prepare a draft DPA annex with the two most likely redlines we see (EU residency addendum and evidence escrow for longer retention). If you want, Marissa will be on the intake call to capture acceptance criteria and update the MAP timeline live.

Action items before Thu 11:00 PT:
- AuroraFin: share the product deployment plan (hosted vs eu-region vs on-prem) — Elena/Samir
- Redwood: send the SOC2 index & CAIQ lanes in the Drive link; Vanessa to drop DPA draft by EOD 12/2

Thanks — look forward to the intake.

Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Solutions & Procurement
Redwood Inference
